MOLIN_RELIC_MOLIN_RELIC.title: Template Relic
MOLIN_RELIC_MOLIN_RELIC.description: Whenever an enemy dies, gain [blue]6[/blue] Max HP and heal [blue]6[/blue] HP. When you take unblocked damage, lose Max HP equal to half that damage, rounded down, and lose the same amount of current HP, to a minimum of [blue]1[/blue].
MOLIN_RELIC_MOLIN_RELIC.flavor: A sample relic used to verify the template project.
